name: Roche Holding AG (Genussschein)
businessSummary: Swiss pharma and diagnostics group. 2025 sales CHF 61.5bn: Pharmaceuticals about 47.7bn, Diagnostics about 13.8bn. Growth drivers Xolair, Hemlibra, Ocrevus, Phesgo, Vabysmo; pipeline includes giredestrant, fenebrutinib, obesity assets.

Oddo BHF double upgrade 20 Oct; stock at highest level since 2022.
Positive Ph3: sefaxersen (IgAN), Lunsumio; Elecsys pTau217 FDA clearance; 2027 outlook: similar sales momentum with margin expansion.

valuation.method: Next-12m core EPS x justified P/E. Basis CHF 20.0 (FY2025 core EPS 19.46, about 5pp currency drag in 2026; lead estimate). Price/range from a single provider line (RO), consistent with market cap. Historical multiple ranges not verified by agents; justified multiples are lead estimates.

bear.note: Biosimilar erosion and a weak USD offset growth. Justified multiple 15x on next-12m 20.40.

base.note: Mid-single-digit sales growth, stable core margin, diagnostics recovery. Justified multiple 19x on next-12m 21.20.

bull.note: Obesity and neurology pipeline readouts succeed. Justified multiple 21x on next-12m 21.60.

valuation.whyItFits: Pharma plus diagnostics leader: Q3 sales +7% CER, beta 0.17, 2.4% dividend, strong balance sheet.
valuation.growthDrivers: Vabysmo, Ocrevus, Xolair, Polivy, diagnostics, giredestrant and obesity pipeline.
